speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief, brethren. And we shall not be. Two turns of the glass, and fourteenthly is where I am bound.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two turns is the Sunday I came for. I have a dinner under a cloth at home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir John is in his pew. He has the book open. He is not adding to it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The Mayor may keep his own counsel. I am not preaching his pew. I am preaching the hour.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then preach it, and let the glass do the stopping. I can hear a fourteenthly without adopting it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly, the day is the Lord's before it is the street's. A parish that only counts who is missing will soon have nothing else to count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not making a mark for this morning. The morning was the glass.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. A morning without a story is a morning I can sit beside.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: No story from this porch. The glass has a second turn in it. Sit through it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit through it. The book at home has no cross for today, and it will not gain one on the way.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The close is hot enough without a second sermon on the cobbles. We go when he stops.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I stop when the glass stops. Fourteenthly is a heading, not an invitation to stay the afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we have the heading, sir. I am not asking for the next one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John has not turned his head. Leave him that.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The responses are said. What a man does not add, I will not supply from the step.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing added. I am taking home the two turns, and the word fourteenthly, and a dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The dinner is the part I trust. Come off the step before the heat sits on the stair.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Go home within the parish. The glass is done. I have no third turn for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Within the parish. The sheet on the board can wait. It has waited.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It can wait without being talked of in a porch. I have not come here to discuss a letter.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: God keep this parish through the heat. I have nothing else.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing else from me, sir.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are finished. Two turns. I counted them so I would know when to stand.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Stand, then. The porch is not a chapter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Standing. Sir John may keep the pew. I am not waiting on a word he has not offered.
